title: NCC 2022 livable housing provisions
disclaimer: The livable housing provisions introduced in NCC 2022 for Class 1a and Class 2 dwellings. ADOPTION IS NOT UNIFORM: several jurisdictions deferred or varied these provisions, and at least New South Wales and Western Australia have not adopted them on the national timetable. Confirm whether they apply in your state before treating any finding here as binding. Only the provisions that can be read off a floor plan are encoded -- step-free thresholds, sanitary compartment layout, reinforcement for future grabrails, shower construction and the rest are not.

rules.title: Doorway clear width
rules.message: A doorway serving {serves} gives {clear_width_mm} mm clear; the livable housing provisions require 820 mm.
rules.note: Measured clear of the open door leaf and its stop. Door hardware may encroach.

rules.title: Entrance doorway clear width
rules.message: The entrance doorway gives {clear_width_mm} mm clear; 820 mm is required, with a step-free threshold.
rules.note: The step-free threshold and the path from the property boundary are also required and are not checked here.

rules.title: Corridor clear width
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm wide; the livable housing provisions require 1000 mm clear between the finished surfaces of opposing walls.
rules.note: Skirtings, architraves, door stops, conduits and power outlets may be disregarded.
